Cross-references the cloud Kael sessions (GLOBAL-D-301 + this) — local desktop + cloud platform render the same session canvas component (three-surface reuse per GLOBAL-D-296). The canvas IS the slack-thread-equivalent that Harvey Spectre / incident.io / software-factory.dev all converged on.
